parent_objective: design a broader public replay escalation gate for the M1362 alpha 0.1 candidate
blocked_by: M1362 alpha 0.1 has passed only exact metrics plus M267/M264 and M183/M170 preflight

public_gates: M1364 must not update actor weights
M1364 must not use private holdout
M1364 must design six-surface public replay before protected-key and behavior gates

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the M1362 two-surface preflight candidate into a broader public replay escalation plan
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, replay, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the design routes directly to promotion
stop if the design skips six public replay surfaces
stop if the design uses private holdout
stop if the design omits exact non-regression
fallback_plan: if broader replay design is complete, route to a no-training public replay implementation
if required corpora are missing, route to corpus availability audit
if protected-key policy is ambiguous, keep protected diagnostics after replay rather than before
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1363 routes M1362 alpha 0.1 out of two-surface preflight but blocks promotion

admission_evidence: M1362 alpha 0.1 passes M267/M264 and M183/M170
M1363 blocks direct promotion and PPO
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: design lists six public replay surfaces
design states protected-key and behavior ordering
design states no promotion until public stack is complete

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1364 designs public replay escalation and cannot claim anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: design must preserve wrong-history replay proof surfaces before broader behavior claims
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362 selected checkpoint and public replay preflight artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If broader replay fails later, classify the failed surface before adding new objectives or tuning alphas.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: M1362 alpha 0.1 should be escalated to a broader public replay design before any PPO, private holdout, or promotion route.
success_criteria: design lists the six replay surfaces
design orders replay before protected-key diagnostics and behavior seeds
design blocks promotion and private holdout
no training, PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design routes directly to promotion or private holdout
training, PPO, replay, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1364 passes as a design milestone only if it specifies broader public replay escalation while keeping training, replay, PPO, private holdout, promotion, and actor-input changes blocked.
